[b][color=#6aa84f]What you need to note:     [/color][/b]

[left]this file only has individual directories, it does not contain any furniture, [/left]
[left]it is just a carrier.[/left]
[left]I will indicate in every future furniture mod whether it will use this furniture catalogue.[/left]
[left]By then, when you have downloaded the catalogue and furniture, you can take those furniture items from the catalogue.[/left]

[color=#6aa84f][b]Run:      [/b]
[/color]
You need to download cp as a prerequisite, otherwise this directory will not take effect. 

[b][color=#93c47d]Change appearance:[/color][/b]

The cp tag file defaults to the oak appearance
 if you want more appearances, you need to download the at tag appearance add-on package.
